title: Runner Readiness Fixture
goal: Prove that a harmless path-scoped maintenance task can be planned as ready without executing it.
acceptance: The dry-run report is ready when the source worktree is clean.
Path include rules make future changed-file scope enforceable.
Declared approval gates remain armed but do not block until triggered.
The runner performs no branch, worktree, commit, push or Codex execution.

commands.reason: Focused runner tests must prove execution-readiness semantics.
Machine-readable agent task fixtures must remain valid.
The repository baseline must stay green.
The final patch must not contain whitespace errors.

manual: Confirm no Codex CLI execution, worktree creation, branch creation, commit or push was performed by dry-run.

risk.notes: This fixture is restricted to runner tooling, tests and documentation.

requiresApproval.reason: Adding dependencies would change the supply-chain contract and requires owner approval.
Any destructive filesystem operation remains outside dry-run and requires owner approval.

notes: This is an execution-readiness fixture, not an active roadmap task.
